notes.title: Retro Inventory Patch
notes.notes:
Retro Inventory

We've now added a Retro-styled Inventory!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28406341/adf5c9fba82492269727cb39f1db70e8617e0970.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28406341/0c0254922d9517e9b62f6cf4df330924d7881cfd.png

You can enable it under Options>Retro. We didn't enable it by default as the Retro Inventory only supports English at the moment. Let us know what you think!

Language mods

We have made some internal change to the engine to make it easier for people to provide and maintain language mods. Some third-party mods have been in the work for Russian, Chinese Simplified, etc. Check out for the modding/hacking discussion forum where current and future creator may post them!

Traply yours,
The Lizardcube and DotEmu teams.

notes.title: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap will release on PC this week
notes.notes: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap originally released in 1989 as a Sega Master System exclusive, and in my opinion, it was among the best titles for that console. Earlier this year a remake launched for the Nintendo Switch, and it's probably among the prettiest remakes of an 8-bit platformer ever made, but crucially, the remake can also be played with its original pixel-style graphics.The game launches June 9 on Steam and GOG, and while there are more fun and complex platformer adventures available in this day and age, anyone with a lingering nostalgia for old classics will likely enjoy The Dragon's Trap. In a neat twist, you can switch between the modern graphics and the 8-bit graphics mid-game.Check out the PC launch trailer below:
